subject: Request: evidence of recent penetration testing and remediation for procurement gate
messages:
From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@novuspay.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Procurement checkpoint: pen test report required for MAP gating

Hi Laura,

Hope you're well. Quick ask from our procurement team as we move toward signature on DEAL-1842 — our security reviewer needs the most recent penetration test report and a short note on outstanding remediation items. The formal MAP gating checklist requires: 1) a redacted pen test report (within the last 12 months), 2) a remediation tracker showing open/closed items, and 3) confirmation whether the test scope included customer-managed data flows.

Our deadline to clear procurement gating is Tuesday, 2026-12-01 COB Pacific. Can you confirm whether you can provide those artifacts by then, and if any items will need to be redacted?

Thanks,
Samantha Lowe
Senior Procurement Manager — NovusPay
procurement@novuspay.com

[Attachment: MAP_checklist.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@novuspay.com>, Aaron Delgado <aaron.delgado@novuspay.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement checkpoint: pen test report required for MAP gating

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear checklist and deadline. Short answer: yes, we can provide a redacted penetration test report and a remediation tracker that meets the MAP requirements. A couple of quick notes so expectations are aligned:

- The latest internal test was completed 2026-08-14; we maintain a redacted public copy and a more detailed internal copy.
- We will redact IP addresses, customer identifiers, and limited vulnerability PoC details for distribution to procurement.
- Current open items are small-medium severity and most are already in our engineering backlog; the tracker will contain ETA estimates for each.

I'll attach the redacted PDF and a remediation tracker draft by Monday morning (2026-11-30) at the latest. If you require unredacted evidence for an on-prem review, we'll need an NDA amendment and an escalated access request — please advise.

Looping in Soojin (security) and Rishi (engineering) to confirm any outstanding tickets that could affect gating.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement checkpoint: pen test report required for MAP gating

Laura / Rishi — quick internal status:

- Attached is the redacted PDF we typically circulate externally (redacted_pentest_report_v2.pdf). It omits PoCs and customer-specific identifiers; full report exists internally.
- The remediation tracker (remediation_tracker_v3.xlsx) currently lists 7 open items: 3 low, 3 medium, 1 high (the high is a dependency in our auth gateway but has a mitigated config patch applied in prod; we'll include mitigation details).
- ETA for closing medium items: two by 2026-12-10, one by 2026-12-22. Low items are scheduled in routine sprints.

Ask for procurement: if they accept redacted report + tracker with mitigations and timelines we should be able to clear MAP gating. If procurement insists on unredacted evidence, we need an NDA addendum and a limited, auditable access window — please flag that in your reply to Samantha.

Priyom — can you confirm the engineering ETA on the medium item tracked as ID MT-347 (auth session fixation mitigation)? A one-liner update is fine.

Thanks,
Soojin
Senior Information Security Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 07:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement checkpoint: pen test report required for MAP gating

On Mon, Nov 29, 2026 at 08:17 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Priyom — can you confirm the engineering ETA on the medium item tracked as ID MT-347 (auth session fixation mitigation)?

Priyom's update: MT-347 is deployed to prod with the configuration mitigation in place at 2026-11-27; full code change scheduled and will be merged by 2026-12-06. We will mark it as mitigated in the tracker and provide the PR and deployment ticket references. Other medium items have similar mitigation notes or scheduled fixes.

I'll consolidate the redacted report and the tracker now and send to Samantha by end of day.

—Rishi

From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@novuspay.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Aaron Delgado <aaron.delgado@novuspay.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement checkpoint: pen test report required for MAP gating

Thanks Laura and team — that plan sounds reasonable. A couple follow-ups from procurement/security: 1) please include a short cover note that lists the redaction categories and the date of the original test, 2) attach the remediation tracker with a column for status and expected close date, and 3) we also require a completed SIG questionnaire or CAIQ snapshot if available (our security review tool prefers SIG Lite answers).

If you can get the redacted report + tracker + cover note + SIG/CAIQ snapshot uploaded to the HubSpot deal record (link below) by COB tomorrow (2026-12-01), procurement will clear the MAP gate and move to signature. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1842

Best,
Samantha
Senior Procurement Manager — NovusPay
